hints.title: Ordered Assignment Property
hints.text: Sorting robots and factories guarantees optimal paths never cross each other. Robots in left-to-right order match factory capacity slots in left-to-right order.

hints.title: Slot Flattening
hints.text: Expand factory capacities into individual factory slot locations. Sort both robots and factory slots.

hints.title: Sequential Cost Minimization
hints.text: Define state dp[i][j] as the minimum distance to repair the first i robots using a subset of the first j factory slots.

hints.title: Linear Table Matching Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minimumTotalDistance(self, robot: list[int], factory: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        robot.sort()
        factory.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
        slots = []
        for pos, cap in factory:
            slots.extend([pos] * cap)
        n, m = len(robot), len(slots)
        dp = [float('inf')] * (m + 1)
        dp[0] = 0
        prev = [0] * (m + 1)
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            cur = [float('inf')] * (m + 1)
            for j in range(i, m + 1):
                cur[j] = min(cur[j - 1], prev[j - 1] + abs(robot[i - 1] - slots[j - 1]))
            prev = cur
        return prev[m]
```

variables: m: total capacity across all factories
complexity.notes: Table state optimized down to previous and current row buffers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive bipartite matching runs in O(n! * m) exponential search.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m) space using rolling state vectors.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes non-crossing matching property on 1D lines and applies flattened slot transitions.
